name: Samukawa Reiji
source:
Chizuru's son. A boy who still hasn't completely shed his childishness.

Kind-hearted, independent, fundamentally serious and pure, yet like Chizuru, he succumbed to the abnormally heightened sexual desire in the confined space, becoming addicted to the pleasure of sex with her.

He loves Chizuru deeply, both as family and as a woman.
